exercises.why: **выйти** — вы́йти (perfective): to exit, to go out; to appear, to be published; to spend, to be used up; to come off, to come out. Wiktionary: вы́- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **Вырази** — вы́разить (perfective): to express, to convey (meaning). Wiktionary: вы́- + рази́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **выразить** — вы́разить (perfective): to express, to convey (meaning). Wiktionary: вы́- + рази́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to take out, to pull out, to draw out, to extract
to let out, to let go, to release, to set free
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́пить — to drink, to drink up; вы́нуть — to take out, to pull out, to draw out, to extract; вы́пустить — to let out, to let go, to release, to set free; вы́звать — to call, to send for.
**вырос** — вы́расти (perfective): to grow, to increase; to arise, to appear, to rise up, to sprout; to grow up. Wiktionary: вы- + расти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **выбрал** — вы́брать (perfective): to choose, to select, to pick out; to elect; to take everything out; to haul in (net), to pull up (anchor). Wiktionary: вы- + брать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to take out, to lead out, to bring out, to move out; to help out (help someone to get off)
to hear out, to listen (to the end)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́вести — to take out, to lead out, to bring out, to move out; to help out (help someone to get off); вы́разить — to express, to convey (meaning); вы́слушать — to hear out, to listen (to the end); вызыва́ть — to call, to send for.
**выбрал** — вы́брать (perfective): to choose, to select, to pick out; to elect; to take everything out; to haul in (net), to pull up (anchor). Wiktionary: вы- + брать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **выступать** — выступа́ть (imperfective): to project, to protrude, to jut, to jut out, to come out, to stand out; to step forth, to step forward; to set out, to march off; to appear on the surface. Wiktionary: вы́- + ступа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to jump out, to leap out
to choose, to select, to pick out
to project, to protrude, to jut, to jut out, to come out, to stand out
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́расти — to grow, to increase; вы́скочить — to jump out, to leap out; вы́брать — to choose, to select, to pick out; выступа́ть — to project, to protrude, to jut, to jut out, to come out, to stand out.
